benefits.title: One broker. Five certified origins. Zero inherited compliance failures.
benefits.description: We pre-qualify every supplier so you don't inherit their compliance failures. Trident works with a curated network of USFDA-certified packers across India, Ecuador, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Argentina.

benefits.title: Pricing, lab reports, packaging photos, shipment status — not just updates when something goes wrong.
benefits.description: You get full visibility at every stage. We are not a middleman that adds opacity. We are the layer that removes it.

benefits.title: Our fee is a fixed brokerage. You see the supplier cost, our fee, and your landed cost. No mystery margin.
benefits.description: We operate on transparent, agreed brokerage terms. You see supplier pricing, our fee, and the landed cost clearly — every single time.

benefits.title: Every commercial invoice, phytosanitary certificate, and COO — drafted, cross-checked, and delivered before the container is loaded.
benefits.description: We remove the paperwork risk so your shipment clears cleanly at every destination port. No surprises at customs.

benefits.title: We don't own the product. We don't own the vessel. Our only incentive is making sure you never get a bad shipment.
benefits.description: We work for the buyer. Always. Our only job is making sure you get exactly what was promised — with the inspection reports, packaging visuals, and supplier credentials to prove it.
